svg.title: Rolling 5-day window computing cumulative returns
svg.desc: Vertical diagram showing the SPY return column on the left and the rolling 5-day cumulative-return output column on the right with a dashed rectangle highlighting the first window position over Days 0 through 4, an arrow pointing from the window to the first valid output value at Day 4, and NaN values for Days 0 through 3 reflecting the warm-up period when not enough history exists yet.
svg.text: Rolling 5-day window: how each cumulative-return value is computed
Days 0–3 are NaN because no full 5-row window fits yet.
Day 5 uses Days 1–5, Day 6 uses Days 2–6, and so on through Day 99.
For the 21-day window, the same logic applies with NaN for Days 0–19 and valid values from Day 20 onward.
